versions.changelog:
Initial public release of material-symbols-cli.

- Search, browse, and get details for 3,900+ Google Material Symbols icons.
- Download SVG or Android Vector Drawable XML icons; batch download all Android sizes.
- Generate ready-to-use HTML, CSS, and @font-face snippets for web projects.
- Output Kotlin/Jetpack Compose code for Material Symbols icons on Android.
- Supports icon style, fill, weight, size, and output format customization.
- All commands support structured JSON output for scripting/automation.
